cards.title: Where are the docs?
cards.body: Different boards and modules map to different manuals.

cards.title: How to ask?
cards.body: Version, steps, logs and prior investigation decide response speed.

slides.title: By the end of this lesson
slides.lead: You'll turn the RDK ecosystem into a mental map you can navigate quickly.

slides.lead: Always look at README, then branch, then Issues.

cards.title: README
cards.body: Read features, platforms, install and run steps first.

cards.title: Branch
cards.body: rdk_x5 / rdk_x5_legacy / rdk_x3 / rdk_s — wrong branch breaks the flow.

cards.title: Issues

slides.title: Do three things before you post

steps.title: ① Search the forum
steps.sub: Use the error message or feature name.

steps.title: ② Check the docs
steps.sub: Make sure your steps match the manual.

slides.title: Three rules for a good post

cards.title: ① Specific title
cards.body: "RDK X5 HDMI 4K display broken" — not "help" or "anyone please look".

cards.title: ② One issue per post
cards.body: Don't mix HDMI + ROS + camera issues in the same thread.

cards.title: ③ Full description
cards.body: What you're doing, what you're using, what happened, expected, actual difference.

slides.title: Four baseline debug steps (with commands)
slides.lead: Many issues are already fixed in newer images or miniboot. Running these four steps first saves everyone's time.

cards.title: ① Check versions
cards.note: Report at least system image version and miniboot version.

cards.title: ② Update packages
cards.code: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade
cards.note: Make sure critical apt packages are up to date.

cards.title: ③ Update miniboot
cards.note: Low-level fixes often ship via miniboot.

cards.title: ④ Run the official demo
cards.note: If the demo works, the issue is in your changes — diff to find it fast.

slides.title: What a good question looks like

cards.title: Title
cards.body: Board model + feature module + specific symptom.

cards.title: Environment
cards.body: Board, system version, image and package state.

cards.title: Steps
cards.body: Reproduction steps, expected result, actual result.

cards.title: References
cards.body: Links to manual, GitHub, Model Zoo, forum.

cards.title: What you tried
cards.body: Prior debug, cable swap, official demo run, Issues search.

cards.title: Logs
cards.body: Full logs — not just the last error line.

cards.title: Can't find it in the docs?
cards.body: Check the board series first — X3 / X5 / S100 have separate docs. Use the left nav to switch.

cards.title: GitHub is slow?
cards.body: Use a proxy or a mirror like Gitee. Key snippets also appear in the docs and NodeHub.

cards.title: NodeHub version mismatch?
cards.body: Check the platform filter first, then the README's required system version. Upgrade the image if needed.

cards.title: Toolchain questions?
cards.body: For algorithm toolchain issues, use Tiangong Assistant: chat.oe.horizon.auto
